cells.scene: A simple wooden raft made from several logs lashed together floats on calm water, no motor or hull.
A cutaway of a small house shows stout concrete foundations buried below ground level supporting the walls, clearly load-bearing base.
A thick wooden support post firmly braces a heavy beam, broad strong cross-section and stable construction.
Floodwater rises to submerge a small empty garden bench, only its upper back still above water.

prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational. Create ONE SQUARE 2x2 atlas with four equal square cells for an adult vocabulary app. Attached image is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: restrained ink-and-watercolor educational illustrations, clear dark blue-charcoal outlines, pale blue wash, small warm natural color accents. Pure WHITE opaque background. Central 75% of each quadrant contains its subject with generous margins. Nothing crosses midlines. Leave horizontal 45–55% and vertical 47–53% center bands EMPTY WHITE. Natural human anatomy, recognizable objects, clear 320px silhouettes, restrained detail, no elaborate environment. NO captions, labels, writing, borders, grid lines, watermarks or logos. Only symbols or numerals explicitly requested in a cell are allowed. Meanings are guidance; never write them. Row-major fixed order. FOUR CELLS:
TOP LEFT — raft (n.木筏): A simple wooden raft made from several logs lashed together floats on calm water, no motor or hull.
TOP RIGHT — foundations (n.地基): A cutaway of a small house shows stout concrete foundations buried below ground level supporting the walls, clearly load-bearing base.
BOTTOM LEFT — stoutly (ad.牢固地，粗壮的): A thick wooden support post firmly braces a heavy beam, broad strong cross-section and stable construction.
BOTTOM RIGHT — submerge (v.浸没): Floodwater rises to submerge a small empty garden bench, only its upper back still above water.
CROP SAFETY: each scene is SMALL, at most 60% of its quadrant, with 20% white margins. Top drawings fully end ABOVE 45% image height. Bottom-row heads, hair, thought bubbles and main objects begin BELOW 58% total image height. Nothing crosses midlines. Sparse background detail, light watercolor.
review_notes: Reviewed semantic sense, anatomy and contained crop. Foundation/embedded cutaways legible, retrace return arrow clear, reservoir dam and fingerprint recognizable.
